reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Cold plunges after lifting can blunt some of the muscle-building signal, so if size is the goal I'd keep them away from the hours right after heavy sessions. Better to plunge on separate days or after a run, where recovery matters more than growth. If your goal is pure strength or you just love the cold, it's a fine habit. Tell me your main goal and I'll help you line the week up around it."}
